newsitem.title: DUBAI: GOLF-ENGLISHMAN CARTER HAS BRAIN OPERATION AFTER COLLAPSE.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-ENGLISHMAN CARTER HAS BRAIN OPERATION AFTER COLLAPSE.

text.p: English golfer David Carter has undergone emergency surgery in Dubai to remove fluid from his brain.
The 24-year-old Johannesburg-born player complained of feeling ill during a practice round for the Dubai Desert Classic on Tuesday and returned to his hotel room.
Friends checked his room later and found Carter barely conscious. He was taken to hospital where scans revealed fluid on his brain.
The operation was performed on Tuesday night and a hospital spokesman said on Wednesday that it had gone well.
Carter suffered concussion two weeks ago when he hit his head on a water slide in Sun City, South Africa.
Carter finished 33rd on the European money list last year. His best finishes came in successive weeks earlier in the season when he placed third in the Madeira Island Open and second in Cannes.
Late in the year he won the Indian PGA Championship.
